name: Sarah Knafo - § 66 - Am 5
title: REPORT on European technological sovereignty and digital infrastructure
part_text: 66. Regrets that the discussions on the EU Cybersecurity Certification Scheme for Cloud Services have not brought any results; points out that there are sovereignty considerations, in particular related to the extraterritoriality of binding legal regimes, that must be urgently addressed; invites the Commission to support existing high-level national cloud security certification schemes that combine robust cybersecurity requirements with explicit guarantees of legal sovereignty, in order to establish the highest possible standards for these certification schemes and facilitate their practical implementation; calls on the Commission to also propose a definition of sovereign cloud and its scope of application in the planned cloud and AI development act;
